finding: Temporal stability assessment must consume only observation windows whose primary and independent exhaustive clients have already reconciled for the exact commit; otherwise a stable digest from one client can conceal same-window client disagreement.
uncertainty: The integration has not yet consumed retained authenticated observations from the private repository.
falsification_route: Provide any observation accepted as promotable where either client pair fails exact reconciliation, a provider ceiling is ambiguous, observations overlap, run status is nonterminal, the quiet period is unmet, or canonical digests drift.
privacy_boundary: Contains repository evidence contracts and synthetic test records only; no credentials, private logs, personal data, or raw private source material.
